body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Microsoft’s Surface computer will make its commercial debut April 17 in AT&T stores in New York City, Atlanta, San Antonio and San Francisco to help sell handsets and calling plans.
(Picture: Microsoft unveiled the MS Surface during CES 2008)

Shoppers can learn about phones' features by placing them on the display of the Microsoft Surface devices, AT&T may install the computers in all of its 2,200 stores if the first ones test well with shoppers.

Equipped with a 30-inch reflective surface in a clear acrylic frame, Microsoft Surface is a forthcoming multi-touch developed as a software and hardware combination technology that allows multiple users to manipulate digital content by the use of natural motions, hand gestures, or physical objects.
